Professional Summary
Detail-oriented backend and full-stack developer with experience delivering scalable Node.js services and containerized applications. Works across TypeScript-based codebases, AWS deployments, and ReactJS frontends to improve performance, reduce costs, and accelerate release cadence. Not open to relocation; looking for roles in Chennai only. Notice period: 15 days.

Technical Skills
Node.js, TypeScript, AWS, Docker, ReactJS, Jira, Linux, Git

Work Experience

Node.js Developer, HCLTech (Feb 2024 - Present)
- Implemented microservices in TypeScript and Node.js that handled user authentication and session management; reduced average response latency by 28% through async optimizations and connection pooling. (TypeScript, Node.js, AWS)
- Containerized services using Docker and standardized CI/CD pipelines, cutting environment drift and accelerating deployments from days to hours. (Docker, Node.js)
- Deployed and monitored services on AWS, configured autoscaling groups and CloudWatch alerts to maintain 99.9% uptime during peak loads. (AWS, Node.js)

Backend Engineer, Zentrix Labs (Mar 2023 - Jan 2024)
- Built Node.js APIs to support a real-time analytics dashboard consumed by React frontend, improving data refresh rates by 3x. (Node.js, ReactJS)
- Integrated backend services with CI workflows and Git-based code reviews using Git and Jira for sprint tracking, reducing bug turnaround time by 35%. (Git, Jira, Node.js)
- Hardened Linux server deployments and automated container builds to ensure consistent staging and production environments. (Linux, Docker)

Full Stack Developer, CartNest (Sep 2022 - Feb 2023)
- Developed full-stack features with TypeScript-backed Node.js services and ReactJS components for cart and checkout flows, increasing conversion rate by 12%. (TypeScript, Node.js, ReactJS)
- Packaged applications into Docker containers and orchestrated local development environments to streamline onboarding for new engineers. (Docker, TypeScript)
- Managed source control and release tasks using Git and tracked work items in Jira to maintain sprint commitments. (Git, Jira, Node.js)
